records.rationale: The packet holds the claim header and status history (intake.md, status_history.md), the phone transcript (call_excerpt.md), the adjuster notes (adjuster_notes.md), a one-page medical summary (medical_summary.pdf) and three photos. The transcript, medical summary and claim header agree on the date of loss (2025-09-19) and the injuries reported. The 3-day gap before first care matches the claimant's account. The amount claimed and paid, $59,533.85, is supported on file by only $485.00 in visit charges and a $2,150.00 MRI estimate. The adjuster notes say causation and coverage were confirmed using full records, imaging and a coverage review, none of which is on file. Not on file are the police report, medical exam notes, imaging, provider bill, claimant statement, coverage verification, settlement worksheet and payment confirmation, though all are listed in the document index. The policy status and policy period are blank. The claim needs those records requested and placed on file so a person can review the amount, causation and coverage. Regulation requires human review of this claim regardless of route.
